description: Ahmedabad is preparing for the Lord Jagannath Rath Yatra. Over 23,000 security personnel will be on duty. An AI-based surveillance system will be used for the first time. It aims to prevent stampedes and detect fires. Drones and GPS will also aid surveillance. The Yatra will follow a 16-kilometer route. Meetings are held to promote communal harmony.
body_lead: The AI-based system would also notify police and the fire department in the event of a blaze and warn the police control room about overcrowding along the route, a Gujarat government release said. As per police, 14-15 lakh people are expected to attend the 148th edition of the Yatra. "Under the AI system, the visual analytics software at the police control room will receive live feeds from CCTV cameras and drones deployed on the route.
